name: Sarah
summary: Abraham's wife, who had no children for many years. In her old age God kept His promise, and she gave birth to Isaac.

key_moments.title: Taken into Pharaoh's House
key_moments.description: During a famine, Abram went to Egypt and had Sarai say she was his sister, because she was beautiful. Pharaoh took her into his house, but the LORD struck Pharaoh with plagues, and he sent them away.

key_moments.title: Gives Hagar to Abram
key_moments.description: Having no children, Sarai gave her maid Hagar to Abram, and Hagar conceived. When Hagar looked down on her, Sarai treated her harshly, and Hagar ran away.

key_moments.title: Renamed Sarah
key_moments.description: God changed Sarai's name to Sarah. He promised to bless her and give Abraham a son by her, and said nations and kings would come from her.

key_moments.title: Laughing at the Promise
key_moments.description: When the LORD said Sarah would have a son, she laughed to herself, because she and Abraham were old. The LORD asked if anything is too hard for Him.

key_moments.title: Gives Birth to Isaac
key_moments.description: The LORD visited Sarah as He had said, and she bore Abraham a son in his old age. Sarah said God had made her laugh, and everyone who heard would laugh with her.
